algorithm.dimension_bridge: Three-bin masses and 3x3 plans are padded with zeros to the existing ten-bin domain. Exact row/column and normalization preservation are proved. Padded feasibility also reflects back to the original three-bin plan.
algorithm.normalization_guard: The new small model permits arbitrary balanced masses, while the existing ten-bin feasible set requires both total masses one. The bridge explicitly requires probability3?(mu) and probability3?(nu), defined by mass=1; unnormalized balanced cases are not silently identified with that old feasible set.
algorithm.objective_preservation: finite_cost accepts an arbitrary existing ten-bin nonnegative Cost restricted to the first three bins. Its nine-term objective equals existing kant_cost on the zero-padded plan.
algorithm.quadratic_certificate: The fixed cost is squared integer-bin displacement (i-j)^2 on all ten indices0..9. Shared dual prices psi(i)=i and phi(j)=j are feasible because integer d=j-i satisfies d^2>=d, with equality exactly d=0 or1. Forward-adjacent positive support is therefore complementary-slack.
